description: The product including 1aluminum frame, 1 drain tray, 1 cup holder, 1 cutlery holder, 1 bamboo cover& 4 plastic feet cover.
What's your biggestconcern when searching for a dish rack? The risk of rusting, right?
That's why we decided to make this ALUMINUM Dish Rack.

Aluminum is well known as the metal of top graderust-resistance. Not like the chrome plated steel, days go by when the chromelayer wear off, rust becomes a part of the dish rack. Besides, we anodized thealuminum to make it better. Literally, you just don’t need to worry about therust issue with this dish rack.

Your next concern might be whether it has ENOUGH SPACE. 13dishes, 6 bowls, 5 cups & more than 60 forks & knives can be put in thedish rack. It basically solved the problem of placing the entire cutlery.
Besides, it is easy to CLEAN. All components of aluminum dishrack can be removable, such as, removable drain tray, cutlery holder &cupholder, that is convenient to clean each part.
So, isn’t the dish rack your perfect choice?
